ammonia.reason: Low deamination of amino acids by starter/non-starter LAB in short 21-45 day age.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from cow milk and no washed rind coryneforms.

bitter.reason: Limited accumulation of hydrophobic peptides from rennet/chymosin proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard between residual galactose and lysine on heating semi-aged curd.

buttery.reason: Moderate diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism in young pasteurized curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low lipolysis to butanoic/hexanoic acids due to pasteurization and short aging.

creaminess.reason: Smooth fat-in-moisture emulsion at ~27% fat and 44% moisture, uncooked pressed texture.

crumbliness.reason: Supple pressed paste with intact para-casein network, not dry or granular.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard pressed body with minimum 53% dry matter, sliceable but elastic.

floral_honey.reason: Trace 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by starter LAB.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification by LAB esterases in short ripening.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in branched C8-C10 acids; no caprine 4-methyloctanoic acid character.

malty_nutty.reason: Mild Strecker aldehydes 2/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism during ripening.

melt.reason: Good flow from rennet gel pH ~5.4 with calcium-solubilized casein that softens on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from thin natural rind flora linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from ~50% fat-in-dry-matter on melting.

smoky.reason: No wood smoking and no guaiacol formation; black coating is wax/plastic, not smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mild lactic acid tang to pH <=5.3 at draining, very low acetic acid.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading and no aligned para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide from methionine catabolism; pasteurized mild culture.

sweet.reason: Faint residual lactose/galactose and proline/glycine sweetness in young paste.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate release by lactococcal peptidases without long proteolysis.
